notes: FleetComm 1.3.4 — pin it. FleetComm now keeps a permanent copy of itself under your user profile and puts FleetComm in your Start menu; open it from there (or right-click the running window ▸ Pin to taskbar) and the pin keeps working through every update, because updates replace that copy in place. You will see a one-time note in the COMM LOG when it is set up; the file you downloaded can be deleted afterwards. Everything from 1.3 rides along: the two-minute walkthrough (SYS ▸ HELP) and the helmet-cam wall with its recorder burn-in and talking outline.
